testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-12c Parameters opens the part parameter table ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion ✔ When the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Parameters ✔ Then a Parameters dialog opens for the active part ✔ And the table includes parameter name, consumed-by, unit or type, equation, nominal value, tolerance and model value columns ✔ When the user clicks Done ✔ Then the extrusion panel remains open ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the accepted feature remains unchanged
